findings.summary: /v1/voice/transcribe (and synthesize/turn) raises unhandled httpx.HTTPStatusError (HTTP 500) on upstream Sarvam failures instead of returning gateway error 502/504
findings.expected: Safe invariant: no 500 on upstream host errors; upstream Sarvam STT/TTS HTTP failures must fail closed with HTTP 502 Bad Gateway or 504 Gateway Timeout (piece stabilise-and-auth §6.9, §2.2)
findings.actual: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error due to unhandled httpx.HTTPStatusError: Server error '500 Internal Server Error' for url 'https://api.sarvam.ai/speech-to-text'
findings.repro: app_module.voice_agent.api_key = 'k'; client.post('/v1/voice/transcribe', json={'audio_base64': '...'}, headers=bearer(roles=['staff'])) when Sarvam returns 500
findings.resolution: Fixed: VoiceAgent maps Sarvam timeouts to VOICE_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT (504) and status/transport/non-JSON errors to VOICE_UPSTREAM_ERROR (502) on transcribe, synthesize and turn; tests/unit/test_gaps_fixes.py.
